interactiveProtocol: P0/V0 absorb makeFoldTranscript public input, shape digest, instances, prior claims, and transcript seed
V1 derive piCCS alpha[0..log2(shape.m)-1] and gamma from makeQOracle
P1 send sum-check claimed sum and one polynomial message per Boolean variable
V2 derive one Ext2 challenge after each sum-check polynomial message
P2 send piCCS final evaluation claims at the sum-check final point
V3 derive one Phi81 ring random-linear-combination challenge per piCCS final claim
P3 send folded claim plus deterministic PiDEC decomposition commitments/evaluations
V4 verify sum-check, piRLC recomposition, and PiDEC recomposition
proofKindProtocols.upperBoundJustification: log2(shape.m) <= 64 from proof decoding limits; piCCSClaimCount <= maxFreshBatchCount + maxPriorClaimCount = 61 + 14
openInputs: challenge sampler uniformity proof for Ext2 and Phi81 ring challenges

interactiveProtocol: Run the fold public-coin protocol
P sends TerminalCEStatement and 219 Stern CE-opening commitment rounds
V derives one rejection-sampled ternary CE challenge per CE-opening round
P sends the challenge-selected CE-opening response for each round
V verifies every CE-opening response and terminal CE relation
openInputs: epsilon_interactive_terminal for fold plus CE-opening composition
ternary rejection-sampling uniformity and exact transcript-query accounting

interactiveProtocol: Run the terminal public-coin protocol
Bind compressed public statement digest and compressed proof-envelope context before verification
V verifies decompression binding and terminal CE relation under the compressed envelope
proofKindProtocols.upperBoundJustification: compressed-terminal adds public digest binding but no extra public-coin challenge beyond terminal

interactiveProtocol: P sends public statement, lane summaries, aggregate digests, scalarization commitments, residual openings, and lane sum-check messages
V derives lane aggregation Phi81 challenges from public statement, lane key, aggregate index, and obligation digests
V derives scalarization Ext2 weights for commitments, decomposition commitments, public input, and matrix evaluations
V derives NumiSeal language and padding Ext2 weights
V derives one Ext2 sum-check challenge per lane proof variable
V verifies lane aggregation, scalarized residual opening, sum-check, and terminal NumiSeal relation
proofKindProtocols.challengeCountFormula: n_numiseal_terminal = sum_aggregates(obligationCount + aggregateCommitmentCount + decompositionCommitmentCount + publicInputCount + matrixEvaluationCount + 2 + variableCount)
proofKindProtocols.upperBoundJustification: NumiSealProductTheoremLimits enforces one product lane, at most 75 source-fold output claims, at most 75 obligations per aggregate, at most 75 aggregates per lane, 1024 public inputs, 1024 matrix evaluations, and 18 sum-check variables; per aggregate n <= 75 + 972 + 972 + 1024 + 55296 + 2 + 18 = 58359, so terminal n <= 75 * 58359 = 4376925
openInputs: sum-check, scalarization, lane aggregation, and residual-opening uniformity proofs

interactiveProtocol: Run the NumiSeal terminal public-coin protocol as the base proof
P binds randomness session digest, mask statements, masked residual statements, and component digest root
V derives three masked-residual accumulation field challenges per lane proof
V verifies randomness-session binding, mask tensor commitments, masked residual equation, and base proof acceptance
proofKindProtocols.upperBoundJustification: NumiSealProductTheoremLimits gives n_numiseal_terminal <= 4376925 and at most 75 lane proofs, while NumiSealZK adds three masked-residual accumulation challenges per lane proof: 4376925 + 3*75 = 4377150
openInputs: ZK simulator composition and masked-residual challenge uniformity proof

qromQueryAndLossInstantiation.dfm20SelectedDepthExpression: epsilon_fs_transform(depth=1) <= max_kind(((2*Q_H+n_kind+1)^(2*n_kind) / n_kind!) * epsilon_interactive_kind + n_kind! / 2^256 + epsilon_precondition_kind)
qromQueryAndLossInstantiation.recursivePromotionExpression: epsilon_fs_transform(depth=d) <= d * max_kind(((2*Q_H+n_kind+1)^(2*n_kind) / n_kind!) * epsilon_interactive_kind + n_kind! / 2^256 + epsilon_precondition_kind)
